meta.name: code-documenter
meta.description: Generates, formats, and validates technical documentation — including docstrings, OpenAPI/Swagger specs, JSDoc annotations, doc portals, and user guides. Use when adding docstrings to functions or classes, creating API documentation, building documentation sites, or writing tutorials and user guides. Invoke for OpenAPI/Swagger specs, JSDoc, doc portals, getting started guides.

copy.tagline: 为代码自动生成并维护技术文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为代码编写或更新文档
copy.tagline_en: Generate and maintain technical documentation for your code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to write or update documentation for your code

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能自动为代码生成文档注释（如 Python 的 docstring、TypeScript 的 JSDoc），创建 OpenAPI/Swagger 接口规范，搭建文档站点，以及编写用户指南和教程。
howto.when: 当你要求为函数或类添加文档注释、创建 API 文档、搭建文档站点，或编写入门指南和教程时触发。

say.text: 给这个 Python 函数添加 Google 风格的 docstring。
为我的 FastAPI 项目生成 OpenAPI 规范。
为这个 TypeScript 类编写 JSDoc 注释。
say.note: Claude 会为所有公共方法和属性添加 JSDoc。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically generate documentation comments for code (e.g., Python docstrings, TypeScript JSDoc), create OpenAPI/Swagger specs, build documentation sites, and write user guides and tutorials.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add docstrings to functions or classes, create API documentation, build documentation sites, or write getting started guides and tutorials.

say_en.text: Add a Google-style docstring to this Python function.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the function and generate a docstring in Google format.

say_en.text: Generate an OpenAPI spec for my FastAPI project.
say_en.note: Claude will detect the framework and output an OpenAPI 3.1 spec file.

say_en.text: Write JSDoc comments for this TypeScript class.
say_en.note: Claude will add JSDoc to all public methods and properties.
